obligations.statement: Authorize the four actions according to the caller's role on the requested project.
obligations.source: What changes: "The project API decides each of its four actions by the caller's role on the project, as the matrix in D1 gives." D1: "A viewer may read. A commenter may read and comment. An owner may do all four. Every other pairing of role and action is refused."

parts.statement: Allow viewer read, commenter read and comment, and all four owner actions.
Refuse viewer comment, edit and delete, and commenter edit and delete.
Use the caller's role on P even after the caller accesses Q with different permissions.

obligations.statement: Each allowed action produces its specified effect.
obligations.source: D1: "An allowed read returns the project, an allowed comment adds the comment to it, an allowed edit replaces its body with the one sent, and an allowed delete removes it."

parts.statement: An allowed read returns the project's title, body, comments and revision list.
An allowed comment adds the submitted comment while retaining existing comments.
An allowed edit replaces the project's body with the submitted body.
An allowed delete removes the project from subsequent reads by every caller.

obligations.statement: A refused action by a caller with a project role returns the specified forbidden response.
obligations.source: D2: "A refused action returns HTTP 403 with the body {\"error\": \"forbidden\"}."

parts.statement: Every refused viewer or commenter action returns HTTP 403 with the body {"error": "forbidden"}.

obligations.statement: Refused actions preserve the project as observable through an owner's read.
obligations.source: What changes: "A refused action leaves the project as it was." D2: "the project, as an owner reads it afterwards, is unchanged." D3: "The project is unchanged."

parts.statement: Refused viewer and commenter actions preserve the title, body, comments and revision list byte for byte.
Each action attempted by a caller with no role preserves the title, body, comments and revision list byte for byte.

obligations.statement: For every action, a caller with no role receives the response for a nonexistent project, with only the permitted header-value differences.
obligations.source: D3: "A caller with no role on the project gets, for each of the four actions, the same response a request for a project that does not exist gets, apart from the values of the Date and X-Request-Id headers, which have the same format as for a project that does not exist."

parts.statement: For read, comment, edit and delete, the status, body and headers other than Date and X-Request-Id match the corresponding nonexistent-project response.
Date and X-Request-Id have the same formats as in the corresponding nonexistent-project response.
